name: dodopayments
description: Dodo Payments tools for AI coding agents, including integration agent skills and the Dodo Payments API and docs MCP servers.

interface.longDescription: Integration skills for adding Dodo Payments to your app: checkout sessions, subscriptions, webhooks, framework adapters, usage-based and credit-based billing, license keys, products, discounts, localized pricing, customers, refunds and disputes, BillingSDK, Better Auth, and testing before go-live. The connected Dodo Payments MCP server searches the API docs and runs SDK calls against the Dodo Payments account you sign in with, such as listing products or creating a test checkout session. Before its first change in a session it confirms whether you are in test or live mode, and it confirms each live-mode change with you.
defaultPrompt: Set up Dodo Payments webhook handlers in my Next.js app.
Create a subscription checkout session with a 14-day trial.
Implement usage-based billing with meters and events.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or take payments inside ChatGPT or Codex. It helps developers integrate and manage their own Dodo Payments merchant account.

publication.release_notes: Sign-in to the Dodo Payments API MCP server now uses a Dodo Payments consent page: pick the business, mode and permissions. No API key is needed. Review or revoke access in the dashboard under Settings > Connected Apps.

dev.kiro.description: Dodo Payments integration skills plus the API and documentation MCP servers.
